test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_many_parts_wide ( id UInt64, u32 UInt32, n8 Nullable(UInt8), arr Array(UInt16), nested1 Nested(a UInt8, b Bool, c UInt32), tup Tuple(f Float32, u UInt16), m Map(String, UInt8) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, parts_to_delay_insert = 100000, parts_to_throw_insert = 100000

CREATE TABLE t_many_parts_compact AS t_many_parts_wide ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 1000000000000, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, parts_to_delay_insert = 100000, parts_to_throw_insert = 100000
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_many_parts_wide SELECT number, toUInt32(number * 13 % 100000), if(number % 7 = 0, NULL, toUInt8(number % 20)), arrayMap(i -> toUInt16(i), range(number % 6)), arrayMap(i -> toUInt8(i), range(number % 5)), arrayMap(i -> i % 2 = 0, range(number % 5)), arrayMap(i -> toUInt32(i * 3), range(number % 5)), (toFloat32(number % 100) / 100, toUInt16(number % 20)), map('k', toUInt8(number % 2), 'm', toUInt8(number % 3)) FROM numbers(50000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 10, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_insert_threads = 1
INSERT INTO t_many_parts_compact SELECT * FROM t_many_parts_wide SETTINGS max_block_size = 10, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_insert_threads = 1
